description:
###### Setting Up:
- Import the UI extension from the Content Library, then enable it on the *UI Extensions* page.
- As root on the appliance, run the bundled installer (idempotent, safe to re-run): **``sudo bash /var/opt/cloudbolt/proserv/xui/jupyter_notebook/install.sh``**. It configures ``jupyterd`` for JupyterLab, applies the security minimums, restarts the service and self-verifies.
- Restart the web service once: **``sudo systemctl restart httpd``**.

###### Accessing Jupyter Notebook:
- *All Admin* → *Admin Extensions* → Jupyter Notebooks. CB admins also get a *Django Notebook* entry in the Bookmarks menu automatically.
###### Additional Information:
- Requires CloudBolt CMP 2026.3.25 or later. See the bundled README for uninstall and troubleshooting.
- [Jupyter XUI user guide](https://cloudboltsoftware.github.io/cloudbolt-forge/sites/NewJupyterXUI/jupyter.html).<hr>
